dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Ha, no. I just play one on stage. See this uniform? Take a closer look, the quality is much worse than an actual uniform.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for the tragically tiny budget the Tri-Coupon Troupe has, I would have a proper costume. A genuine top-quality guard's uniform...
